text: I write on my photos before printing them. First I copy the picture, then I click edit, then text and you can add or edit text and write on the photo. Changes can use font size from 8 to 96 and any color. Then I have it printed. If the printer fails, I try another available printer.
summary: Edit photo text and print it while respecting formatting limits.

workflow.description: Write text on a photo before printing, with fallback to another printer if the first fails.
steps: Edit the photo by adding or editing text
Set text properties (font size 8-96, any color)
If printer fails, try another available printer

function.name: copy_photo
function.description: Creates a copy of the original photo to preserve the original file.

photo_path.description: The file path or identifier of the original photo to copy.

function.name: edit_photo_with_text
function.description: Opens the photo in edit mode and allows adding or modifying text on the image.

photo_path.description: The file path or identifier of the photo to edit.

text_content.description: The text to add or edit on the photo.

function.name: set_text_properties
function.description: Configures the font size and color for the text added to the photo. Font size must be between 8 and 96.

photo_path.description: The file path or identifier of the photo containing the text to style.

font_size.description: The font size for the text, must be between 8 and 96 inclusive.

text_color.description: The color of the text in hexadecimal format (e.g., '#FF0000' for red).

function.name: print_photo
function.description: Sends the edited photo to the default printer for printing.

photo_path.description: The file path or identifier of the photo to print.

printer_id.description: The identifier of the printer to use for printing (optional, defaults to default printer).

function.name: retry_print_with_alternative_printer_if_failed
function.description: Attempts to print the photo using an alternative available printer if the initial print attempt fails.

photo_path.description: The file path or identifier of the photo to print.

available_printers.description: List of available printer identifiers to try in sequence if the first fails.

messages.content: Important rules and constraints: 1. Always copy the original photo before editing to preserve it. 2. Text font size must be between 8 and 96 inclusive. 3. Text color must be specified in hexadecimal format (e.g., '#FF0000'). 4. If the first printer fails, retry with an alternative printer from the available list. 5. All tool calls must use only the provided tools and follow the specified workflow order: copy → edit → set text properties → print → retry if needed.
I want to write 'Happy Birthday!' on my photo and print it.
I can help you with that. First, I need to know the file path or identifier of the photo you want to edit.

I've created a copy of your photo at /home/user/photos/birthday_copy.jpg. Now, I'll add the text 'Happy Birthday!' to it. Next, I need to know the font size (between 8 and 96) and the text color in hexadecimal format (e.g., '#0000FF' for blue).
The print attempt failed because the default printer is offline. I'll try an alternative printer. Could you please provide a list of available printer identifiers to try?
Available printers are: printer1, printer2, printer3
Your photo has been successfully printed using printer2. The text 'Happy Birthday!' is displayed in red with font size 24. Let me know if you need any further assistance!
